description.value: Harrison Hot Springs Resort is a landmark full-service resort on the shores of Harrison Lake, anchored by five natural mineral hot springs pools that rank among the most concentrated in North America. The property includes a wellness spa, multiple restaurants, and the historic Copper Room supper club with nightly live entertainment. It sits at the edge of the Fraser Valley foothills, making it a potential base for road and gravel cycling into the surrounding mountains and lakeside routes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and confirms an active, full-service resort hotel on Harrison Lake with hot springs pools, spa, and multiple dining venues. The phone number '604.796.2244' on the Getaway Package page matches the OSM tag '+1-604-796-2244'. No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, e-bike charging, laundry, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website; the only OSM amenity tags worth noting are internet_access=wlan (unconfirmed by website text) and wheelchair=yes. On-site evening dining is clearly available at The Copper Room, Islands Patio & Lounge, and Gardenia, supporting the 'Nearby evening food' amenity.
concerns: No cycling-specific amenity information (bike storage, e-bike charging, laundry, drying room, tools) found anywhere on the website.
OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but the property is in Harrison Hot Springs, a distinct community — minor administrative grouping issue.
Wi-Fi indicated by OSM tag internet_access=wlan but not mentioned or confirmed on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, operating full-service resort and a credible cycling-tourism accommodation, but the website contains no evidence of any bike-specific services. Both required criteria (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure knowledge) are unconfirmed, so the listing cannot be validated against WWC accreditation requirements without direct contact.
enrichment_extras.notes: Recommend a direct phone or email inquiry to info@harrisonresort.com to confirm bike storage arrangements and any cycling-specific services before making a final include/exclude decision.

Nearby evening food.detail: Multiple on-site dinner venues: The Copper Room (dinner with nightly live entertainment, reservations required), Islands Patio & Lounge (casual menu, cocktails), and Gardenia (sushi, cocktails, wine)
